ports.readOnly: Read-only host listeners. No connections or scans are made. Bind addresses do not establish firewall reachability.
ports.permission: This app needs permission to read host sockets. An administrator can grant it in the App Store; your role must also allow system access.
ports.unavailable: Listening socket data is unavailable on this host. The collector requires Linux and readable /proc data.
ports.loadFailed: Could not read host sockets. Check the agent connection and try again.
ports.simulatedHint: These listeners are simulated by the development host. They do not describe real open ports.
ports.stale: Refresh failed. The previous snapshot remains visible with its retrieval time.
ports.limit: Up to 2,000 listeners are returned. The agent may cache results for 30 seconds. Ports are ordered ascending.
ports.emptyHint: Change or reset the filters to inspect the returned snapshot.
ports.processHint: Process names are shown only when readable by the agent. Missing names are not inferred from service port numbers.
